scope: PR173 idle placement: a foreground lane router on port 18797 with copies of the dobby and severus logins and place_again_after 3m, run at this code against the real accounts, through three starts with capacities that favor one account and then the other; real-account new, resume, restart, idle move, and idle return checks. The idle moves off an account that needs a login or fails the included-only check are covered offline only: a lane cannot hold a login requirement through its start reads or turn paid overflow on. Unchanged historical scenarios are references and were not rerun

matrix.scenario: dobby token is outside the four-hour refresh lead
severus token is outside the four-hour refresh lead
Lane code and executable match the build at e912bea
The lane config sets place_again_after to 3m
new is placed and receives a routed 200
resume within place_again_after stays on the account and keeps the conversation
After a restart that makes the other account score better, a request right after the start stays, because idle time counts from the start
After more than place_again_after without a request, the conversation migrates for idle and keeps its content
After a restart that favors the first account and more than place_again_after from the start, the conversation returns for idle
status -v lists both moves with reason idle, and no problem line names them
cache counts both idle moves at their cache writes, because each started within an hour of the previous request
Identity is the same at the start and the end
Live checks remain within the scoped request budget
Evidence contains no copied access token

prior_acceptance.status: historical reference, not rerun at this code
